requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Date of discharge from probation, with the adjudication of guilt struck, from the discharge order
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Date of discharge from probation, with the adjudication of guilt struck, from the discharge order
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the discharge order is a court record the platform has not seen, and the statute's duty runs from its date
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the date you were discharged from probation and the adjudication of guilt was struck - copy it from the discharge order the Criminal Division clerk gives you; it establishes the date the Sec. 7041(e) duty attached

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Docket number of the deferred-sentence case
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Docket number of the deferred-sentence case
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no case identifier is held for a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the docket number of the deferred-sentence case, copied from your papers or from the discharge order

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Date restitution was satisfied, from the Restitution Unit's statement
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Date restitution was satisfied, from the Restitution Unit's statement
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the restitution bar is statutory and only the Restitution Unit's statement establishes the fact
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the date all restitution was paid in full, from the current balance statement of the Restitution Unit of the Vermont Center for Crime Victim Services - the record cannot be expunged until restitution is paid in full, so do not send the request without this

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: County written into the address block - the county whose Criminal Division entered the deferred sentence
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: County written into the address block - the county whose Criminal Division entered the deferred sentence
requiredBeforeFiling.why: which county's Criminal Division entered the deferred sentence is a case fact the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the county whose Criminal Division of the Superior Court entered the deferred sentence - the request goes back to that same court, under the existing docket

protectedBlanks.label: Date beside the signature on the request
protectedBlanks.why: a date written before the request is signed would be false
